premises.text: Combustion-based power systems are inefficient and emit large amounts of CO2
premises.evidence_span: These combustion power plants fail. They are highly inefficient, they are not flexible, and they emit millions of tons of CO2.

premises.text: A new power generation solution can achieve 80% efficiency and has a carbon-negative footprint
premises.evidence_span: Our solution produces power at a groundbreaking efficiency of 80%. It is fully reversible... it even has a carbon-negative footprint.

premises.text: The new power plant design eliminates combustion and achieves 100% fuel conversion
premises.evidence_span: In our varying units, we have eliminated the combustion completely... we achieve 100% fuel conversion and 80% electric efficiency.

premises.text: The system can produce renewable power from biogas and separate pure CO2
premises.evidence_span: we produce renewable power from the biogas, while separating pure CO2.

premises.text: The reversible system design allows for long-term energy storage
premises.evidence_span: we take excess power from that to produce either green hydrogen or renewable methane. This enables long-term energy storage.

premises.text: Customers can significantly increase their income through the new power generation system
premises.evidence_span: the doubling in electric efficiency first of all means doubling revenues from electricity... they can overall more than five-fold their income.

premises.text: The technology can replace fossil-based power plants globally
premises.evidence_span: we can replace all fossil-based power plants, which is a 7 trillion US dollar market and remove the equivalent of the entire US CO2 emissions from the atmosphere every year.

value.text: The world can achieve decentralized, carbon-negative, and highly efficient power generation
value.evidence_span: join us to provide the world with decentralized, carbon-negative and highly efficient power plants.

notes: No separate premises for market size or specific customer counts as they are not necessary conditions.
